title: BNB Agent Studio
facts: BNB Agent Studio builds TypeScript seller agents that can run locally.
Its quickstart keeps pricing and signing in deterministic code.
This fixed demo corpus does not use Studio's native payment verification.

title: Agent identity and trust
facts: ERC-8004 is a draft proposal for discovering agents and establishing trust.
It describes identity, reputation and validation registries.
Payments are outside the scope of that proposal.

title: Agentic commerce
facts: ERC-8183 proposes a job lifecycle for agentic commerce.
The proposal separates client, provider and evaluator roles.
Repeat's custom checkout is not an ERC-8183 implementation.

title: A bounded buyer mission
facts: Commerce jobs associate work with a payment budget.
In this demo, the owner approves a separate 0.06 wBSC mission cap.
A 0.04 wBSC confirmed payment leaves 0.02 wBSC for that mission; gas uses a separate balance.
